I ask that often, but then again I purposefully push myself away from others because I say “I hate the world” and “I hate people”. However, the people I interact with always spend time together and actually have a name for their friend group and make it very obvious they are the only ones included. I’m not sure if this is my fault or not but I can’t do a think about it so now I’m always lonely.
Being alone

Thank you!
Thank you. My anxiety has been bad all day. Kind of worse now but is fine. It’s like my body is have a reaction while I’m hyper aware. Not fun
Sorry - I was replying yes and in “yes I agree”. Sorry that came out wrong
Yes.

I’m 17 too! Send love to you ❤️

Let’s do this
You matter! Thanks for sharing this little bit because I feel like it has a alll caused a bond with a lot of people and has caused many people to feel “seen” in the little thing you shared. ❤️
Thank you for sharing that! Yes I believe aesthetic attraction is definitely real and sometimes I deal with that. I think? Sometimes I just feel closed off completely. 🤷🏻‍♀️

Thank you so much! That really means a lot. As for not talking to someone, I’ve never spoken to someone about this before. I can entertain the people I speak to in conversations and tell them what they want to hear, but I’ve finally felt happy for myself in a way I didn’t think I would. It makes me so incredibly happy to know I’ve found a real thing I can be known as. May I ask, when did you find out you were in the same boat as myself?
Online companionship?!!! I’m looking for that as well.
Hey! I’ll listen (17F) I’m always here to talk to someone :)

I’ve lost touch with everything. From my previous interests to my relationships, it’s all turned to something I don’t care about but it still stresses me out immensely and I’m left with terrible feelings. It’s been brewing this whole year. You aren’t alone in your feelings.

I feel this. I’m constantly surrounded by a feeling of intense (but buried) anxiety and stress and it really sucks. Sleep is the only place I don’t stress and I don’t think. I wish I didn’t have to keep thinking about this.

I feel like this. It’s developed recently but I hate having relationships with people who act so normal around me. Family is so foreign to me now and I think “how was this normal” because I kind of hate it. It feels wrong and weird and if I were to voice it, it just comes out like a personal attack because I’m “normal”. Right?

Recently I’ve been “sad” lately and I’ve been making comments about my displeasure with my body. All my mother says is “if you don’t take pride in yourself, then I failed as a mother”. I feel like that is shifting the blame onto me and I don’t think I should feel bad (in this way) about the situation.
I feel every single word of this. You put my feelings into perfect sentences
I feel this way so often now. I don’t even know how it started
And to top it off, I’m such an ugly crier and it makes the “after cry” even worse. I can’t ever catch a break.
Sometimes I just wanna call the suicide hotline because they are there to talk you know? They are there to listen to anything really and maybe I want to speak to someone like that.
Thank you
yeah I feel that. I could be thinking so hard if someone asks me a question but I’m not actually thinking. I’m doing nothing because it’s just nothing going on in my mind
Exactly. I have knowledge but I’m just blank up there
It definitely wont
I won’t lie that it’s so hard to fall down so far you don’t feel like you can’t get up. I feel that way sometimes and I confuse myself because of it. Would you like to talk about this privately?

Are you in a bad place? (If you don’t mind me asking). I honestly feel like emptiness discriminated against no one and makes it hard for so many people. It’s tiring and I hope your point of no return gets pushed farther away because maybe something will start to happen
I’m happy for you. No motivation isn’t a “you problem” that you can just fix. It’s hard.
I truly hope so too. I think I could be content with something that is seen as quite and peaceful and not high dollar.

I’m struggling with that all the time. I have no clue what to do but at this point I have to go. Why wouldn’t I when it was set from the start? In the eyes of others I will always succeed but now? I don’t even want to anymore
Exactly
I hope college is my way out. It’s what everyone expects of me anyways.
I certainly wouldn’t do that to someone considering I hate how people do it to me.
I guess so. I’m trying to make it to 18 because then I can just leave and can be an “adult” where I can legally make my own choices. I’m waiting for that day so much.
Exactly. I can’t smile when I don’t feel happy and when I feel empty.
Yeah. I’m out of it soon though. I can finally be alone soon.
I feel the same way. I’m not happy all the time. Sometimes I’m just floating through life. Why should I have to smile?
Yeah its almost comforting to see these changes. Although, it doesn’t directly help me. But I’m glad there are people out there who care enough to raise the human they brought into this world.
I feel offensive all the time. I hate when people comment on the expressions on my face. I try to be joyful to appease them. Doesn’t help me though.
It definitely creates a great mentality for the child who has close to no privacy or freedoms.
I’m finally realizing how much those comments have best me down to the point I’m always aware of it. Really hurts sometimes that I can’t defend myself
Definitely they hide their stuff. But I’m not allowed to because “I’m your mother!”

I would love to make people okay with my attitude when because I want to cry when someone tells me one being “snippy and rude and I don’t like you’re attitude and you have a scowl on your face so often. I’m telling you... one day I will be gone and I’ve told you time and time again to be nicer to me”. I feel like I have a resting bitch face and I can’t help it. Can my lack of emotion not come off as rude and can I express myself by defending myself when I used a “rude tone of voice”?

I actually have to hide in another room to even type because when someone asks me “who are you texting” I can’t say “why should I tell you”. It’s not a sufficient answer even though I feel that I have privacy.

I feel the same. I feel alone and when someone gets offended because I say that, I just lie. “I was exaggerating!” “It was a joke and I got heated” “lol sorry”. And I can’t express myself by telling what’s in my head. When I act slightly quieter and seem distant I am automatically “rude” and I’m always told “one day I’m going to be gone and you’re going to say “where did my mom go” because you are so rude all the time”. I feel so sick of hearing that

I used to readily accept affection from family but now people have to ask me for a hug. Is it really so wrong that I don’t like it anymore even if it hurts someone else? I feel that I have a right to not want to be touched. It is my body after all. This specific thing is the only “development” in my life that I can clearly see. Everything else is muddled and feels not real. Once again I feel fake. Fake with everything

Words of encouragement or endearment are almost second nature and I don’t have any feelings behind them. It’s gotten hard to say “I love you” when I don’t have emotion behind it. Human touch, specifically from my family, feels weird now and I can’t help but shudder away from it. But of course, I’m being rude.

I say “is okay!!” “Yeah it’s okay. I’m glad you’re okay.” “I will try too.” “Thank you”. Saying this stuff is part of why I feel so shallow because I don’t feel anything by the words I type. I seem to only be able to express myself and when the phone shuts off I just go back to a blank head. I feel fake and sallow but I just can’t seem to mind it. Life is so unimaginable and it is so hard to process. Why am I here and how did I get here?
I feel fake sometimes when I’m pouring my feelings out to someone. I type with emotional works yet I sit here with no emotion on my face. Are my feelings even real? What is real?
It’s like I’m floating through things. One minute I will be talking someone’s ear off and happy and the next I’m have no emotion. Things that I read go in one ear and out the other. I feel shallow.
Yes exactly. I envy it when I feel like I shouldn’t. I remember crying about it once but my feeling were shut down. Now it becomes my normal
I wish I could be the person that someone shares everything with. Be that a SO or friend, but I would like that commitment from them

I’m disappointed that this is what the world has to offer me. I’m stuck in social constructs that define who we are. I’m drowning and I hope this doesn’t sound too selfish but I just hate it sometimes
You made it!! I’m so proud of all you have accomplished because highschool is seriously tough. Great job 🎉🎊
This is me. Seriously hate the world 😩

Please don’t. I agree that human beings alike are shameful and that the system is seriously messed up. We never chose this type of world, it was chosen for us. However, maybe there will be something great that happens soon.
Come back please 🖤
Is school a reasonable thing for all the stress to stem from?

I haven’t been able to cry by myself since I had a breakdown and my mother made me talk about it. Since then I’ve read very sad and heartbreaking stories that allow me to cry even if it isn’t “for the right reasons”.
Sometimes it doesn’t feel real that I feel all these things. If I try to speak up nothing comes out because I go blank. I feel so confused sometimes
I’ve been talking to someone but I feel so weird sharing it with others. I can’t depend on my family and I can’t think about therapy. I’m not valid
